name: prestashop-mcp
description: PrestaShop 1.6 to 9: Claude reads your catalog, stock, orders and accounting, and prepares changes you approve.
long_description: Connects Claude to One Shop Manager, the desktop application for PrestaShop 1.6 to 9 (macOS and Windows), already installed on this computer. The application copies the store locally and runs a local MCP server; this extension relays Claude to it. Read tools answer from the local copy. Proposal tools never write to the store: each change waits in the AI log of the application until you open the before/after preview and apply it, and can be undone from the journal. Requires One Shop Manager (14-day free trial) with AI access enabled in Settings › AI settings.

access_key.title: Access key
access_key.description: In One Shop Manager: Settings › AI settings › AI access (MCP), choose Claude Code and copy the key after « Bearer ».

port.title: Port
port.description: Port of the AI access, 47715 unless you changed it in the application.
